answer: Locks are recorded in pearl, expire in inlet, and umber lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 116 aliases as a result needs 11 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4107 identities would post 2042 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
